title: Pamir highway from Osh to Sary-Mogol
text: Got a small taste of the Pamir Highway on our way to the Pamir-Alay mountains. Unfortunately, there’s been quite a bit of snow over the last day or two, so we had to cancel our 4-day hike. Hopefully, we’ll be able to do a couple of day hikes higher up in the mountains once the snow melts.
